claims.text: Improved hygiene and regular chgs of clean clothes = the only Tx needed; pediculicides in some cases
claims.quote: Improved hygiene and access to regular changes of clean clothes is the only treatment needed for body lice infestations; however, in some cases pediculicides are recommended.

claims.text: Machine wash infested clothing and bedding in hot H2O (± 130°F) and dry on ↑heat
claims.quote: Machine wash and dry infested clothing and bedding using the hot water (at least 130°F) laundry cycle and the high heat drying cycle.
